title: Two top-level areas: Calculators and Investments, in one shared frame
changes: A Calculators / Investments switch sits next to the A.NAV logo; the header, logo, market strip and footer stay in exactly the same place in both areas
The calculators are unchanged: their DOM, ids, storage key and backup format are untouched, and they are only hidden while Investments is open
Investments has four views (investment log, portfolio breakdown, performance, cash movements) with empty states; no real or demo data yet, the data model waits for the Excel file
Missing values show as a dash with 'no data', never as zero
The investments area has its own teal accent and uses the existing colour sweep when switching
The chosen area and view are remembered in the browser (anav.shell.v1)
Ctrl+Z does not undo hidden calculator edits while Investments is open
Keyboard: arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs
